_meta.code_constants_locked_to: backtest.py — keep these two files in sync
_meta.live_universe_naming: BTC-PERP-INTX, ETH-PERP-INTX, SOL-PERP-INTX, XRP-PERP-INTX, ADA-PERP-INTX, DOT-PERP-INTX
_meta.backtest_proxy_naming: BTC-USD, ETH-USD, ... — Coinbase Exchange public candles serve spot only

strategy.name: 6H Scanner with Volume + BTC Regime Filter
strategy.description: Multi-asset scanner. Every 6H bar, evaluate all 6 assets. Take the strongest qualifying signal subject to portfolio limits.

indicators.ema_50_6h: Slow trend filter — defines regime (long-only above, short-only below)
indicators.ema_20_6h: Fast momentum confirmation — must align with EMA(50) direction
indicators.rsi_14_6h: Entry trigger — wide thresholds (30/70) for slower timeframe
indicators.volume_avg_20: Volume confirmation — entry candle must show >1.2x avg volume
indicators.btc_rsi_14_6h: Inter-market regime filter — blocks counter-BTC trades at extremes

long: btc_rsi_14_6h >= 35 (skip longs when BTC is dumping)
short: btc_rsi_14_6h <= 65 (skip shorts when BTC is ripping)

signal_ranking: When multiple assets fire simultaneously, take the one with most extreme RSI (furthest from 50). If we already hold a same-direction position, the new signal must be stronger by 5+ RSI points to qualify.

execution.entry_timing: Signal forms on closed 6H bar N. Order fills at bar N+1 open.
exit_logic: 1. Stop loss: 2 ATR from entry (immediate market close on hit)
2. Target 1: 3 ATR from entry — close 50% of position, move stop to breakeven
3. Target 2: 6 ATR from entry — close remainder
4. Time stop: 56 bars (14 days) from entry — market close at bar close
5. Regime flip: close immediately if 6H close crosses to wrong side of EMA(50)
execution.exit_priority_note: Priority order is the order listed above. When stop and target prices both fall inside a single bar's range, the stop is assumed to fire first (conservative). After a partial fill at target 1, the runner is re-evaluated on the NEXT bar with stop at breakeven — the runner is not also closed on the same bar even if target 2 was reached.

position_sizing.method: Fixed dollar risk with ATR stops
position_sizing.formula: notional_usd = risk_usd / stop_distance_pct, then cap at max_notional, margin = notional / leverage

risk_rules.drawdown_baseline: ACCOUNT_SIZE_USD ($500). Drawdown is measured against the running peak of ACCOUNT_SIZE_USD + cumulative_pnl, never against cumulative P&L alone.

cost_assumptions.note: Real funding rate modeling requires historical funding data — placeholder is a conservative flat drag.

blackout_events.implementation: Manual flag in bot config — disable trading on flagged dates per asset.

deployment_gates.backtest: 12+ months of 6H data, net profit factor >= 1.5, max drawdown < 25%, max consecutive losses < 8.
deployment_gates.paper_trade: 30+ days minimum at the same parameters as backtest, with no parameter changes during paper period.
deployment_gates.live_capital_phase_1: $50 (not $500). Hold this size for 30 days of profitable behavior before scaling.
deployment_gates.live_capital_phase_2: Scale only after 30 days of phase-1 live behavior matches paper-trade expectations.

notes: Backtest 12+ months before any deployment. Paper trade 30+ days minimum. Live capital starts at $50, not $500. Scale only after 30 days of profitable live behavior.
